request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Pallas by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Core Rust Libraries, Year 2

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Pallas maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee.
The proposal says the core grant funds a part-time Pallas maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD, including a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve within the vendor request.

Pallas is described as a collection of Rust crates re-implementing core Ouroboros and Cardano primitives including CBOR encoding, cryptographic operations, networking mini-protocols, ledger traversal, transaction building, and address handling.
The document claims Pallas is shared infrastructure used by projects including Aiken, Dolos, Lucid, Oura, Mithril, Amaru, UTxO-RPC, and others.
The document reports Pallas has over 649 pull requests, 199 stars, 91 forks, 60 contributors, and 214,446 crates.io downloads, with GitHub and crates.io links supplied for verification.
The maintainer scope covers codebase maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides voting, documentation, audited results, and audit-report references.
The proposal states the requested amount did not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, either alone or in aggregate.

The proposal says TxPipe previously received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, and also received 2025 Intersect maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC that is being delivered on schedule.

The proposal describes treasury administration through Sundae Labs smart contracts with TRSC and PSSC addresses, named oversight entities, authorization thresholds, audit references, and a public dashboard for tracking funds.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month continuation of Pallas maintenance by TxPipe, submitted by Intersect, with stated open-source infrastructure benefits, adoption metrics, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based treasury oversight.
